opinions.point: Several commenters found the episode entertaining and enjoyed its absurd comedic energy.
Yukari’s presence and interactions were especially well received.
Some viewers liked seeing additional character-focused moments and felt certain character appearances were amusing surprises.
One commenter felt the series was revisiting familiar material and approaching the limits of what this adaptation can sustain, while still finding it generally funny.
A few reactions criticized recurring jokes about weight and perceived yuri-bait as repetitive or unappealing.
